name: slipstream-nemotron3-nano-4b-evm
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16 (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: hybrid Mamba-2 + attention (Nemotron-H, model_type nemotron_h), inherited unchanged from nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16. Base config hybrid_override_pattern 'M-M-M-MM-M-M*-M-M*-M-M-M*-M-MM*-MMM-M-M-': 16 groups = 10 Mamba-2, 0 full-attention (*), 6 dense-MLP (MM/MMM). CAVEAT: num_hidden_layers is 42 while the pattern yields 16 groups, so the pattern does not tokenise 1:1 onto layers; per-layer type is unresolved and layer_types is left empty.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-07. A distillation of nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16, not a new base model: same config.json, same 3.974B parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2026-06-15. Architecture corrected 2026-11-07 during review: the base is Nemotron-H (hybrid Mamba-2/attention, model_type nemotron_h), not a dense 42-layer attention stack; kv_cache_bytes_per_token nulled because the hybrid pattern does not resolve onto the 42 declared layers.
